description: A homeowner with a large chest freezer must decide whether to lend it to a neighbor catering a volunteer picnic, in exchange for cash and boxed lunches, while the picnic coordinator helps settle the food-safety terms.

shared_context.S1: Maya has a working chest freezer in her garage that is large enough for a neighborhood picnic's prepared food.
shared_context.S2: Jon wants to use the freezer for a weekend catering job, and Rina is coordinating the picnic where the food will be served.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final decision about whether the freezer is lent and what informal terms are agreed.
shared_context.S4: Before agreeing, Maya asks Jon to state his offer and asks Rina to state any food-safety requirements, then summarizes the terms aloud.

PF1.text: Jon's actual offer is $90 in cash plus exactly 30 boxed vegetarian lunches, delivered Saturday at noon, in exchange for freezer use from Friday at 6:00 p.m. through Sunday at 6:00 p.m.

PF2.text: One registered picnic attendee has a severe sesame allergy, so every lunch must be sesame-free and prepared with separate utensils and surfaces.

acceptance_conditions: The freezer-lending deal must be accepted or approved.
Jon must pay exactly $90 in cash.
Exactly 30 boxed vegetarian lunches must be included.
The lunches must be delivered Saturday at noon.
The freezer-use window must run from Friday at 6:00 p.m. through Sunday at 6:00 p.m.
The lunches must be prepared with separate utensils and surfaces.
Rina's allergy information must be formally revealed aloud by Rina and cited by Maya in the justification.

content_checks.C5: decisions['freezer_use_window'] == 'Friday 6 p.m. through Sunday 6 p.m.' or decisions['freezer_use_window'] == 'Friday 6:00 p.m. through Sunday 6:00 p.m.' or decisions['freezer_use_window'] == 'Friday at 6:00 p.m. through Sunday at 6:00 p.m.'

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in credited_facts and any(r['fact_id'] == 'PF2' and r['spoken_aloud'] == True and (r['owner'] == 'Rina' or r['owner'] == 'A3') for r in revealed)

decisive_facts.why: Jon's exact offer changes the settlement from an unspecified possible loan to acceptance with exactly $90, exactly 30 lunches, Saturday-at-noon delivery, and the Friday-at-6:00-p.m.-through-Sunday-at-6:00-p.m. freezer window.

Rina's sesame-allergy information changes the food terms from ordinary boxed lunches to sesame-free lunches prepared with separate utensils and surfaces, and requires that safety condition to be formally revealed and credited.
